Mike Wyatt stood at the stairs to the Peoria train station in Aurora, Colorado,
sampled:
on that fateful day and saw a young man approaching a train with a backpack. The train was scheduled to come in 15 minutes but would not be there for 30 minutes.

Wyatt, who lost his sight to glaucoma at 10, said when he looked down, "it was like I was looking into the eye of God. I felt like I was looking into the eye of God. I felt like I would not be here today had that not been a young man reaching down, pulling me back."
